key_reasoning.reason: Touches a new responseReady store, the chatGeneration and chats stores (stream completion and poll completion both call markResponseReady), two app-level hooks (useResponseReadyTab, usePageTitle), the ResponseReadyAnnouncer component, App.tsx and ChatPrompt.tsx. Four or more components across store and UI layers.

No exact precedent for browser Notification API handling in this codebase: permission state, session-level decline memory, and try/catch so a notification failure cannot escape stream completion. Concurrency between stream completion and polling paths adds moderate risk. Rollback is trivial (flag and title). No security or compliance surface.

15 files changed (diffstat), 753 insertions. Roughly 3 new source modules plus about 5 to 6 new or modified test files, and 5 modified source files across src/App.tsx, src/store/, src/hooks/appLevel/, src/components/ and src/pages/chat/. Per the diffstat mapping (11-15 files = XL).
